notes: v1.1.5 - The double-input fix now auto-runs on Xbox too (was PlayStation only). This is the fix for shots releasing late / the shot stick fighting itself - the game was reading your controller AND the app at the same time. Reconnect in the Bridge tab (needs HidHide). Also: meter height read straight from the mask (no more top clipping), steadier shot timing (line-fit fill rate + holds the fastest rate), and a fixed-size detection box that stops zooming with the meter.
